previousPureReview.result: Previously reviewed independent strict WeakMap brand, origin, descriptor, source-range and scalar budget boundary; reused as evidence without rerunning its 6 tests.

verifiedBoundaries.conclusion: Owner identity includes session/catalog/source/binding/instance/backend/language/epoch/readEpoch plus world/base and all four scene provenance fields. Owner changes reset the generation and replace DOM closures. Observed pending or content changes permanently revoke an in-flight operation. Parent switching captures and retains each binding fragment, then refreshes the helper.

Each effective fill first rereads the same explicit scene/assembly; captures through the new first-creation brand; compares origin, selected assembly and complete frozen directory fingerprint; then rechecks owner, full raw JSON, all selections and DOM values before proposing and before callback.

Read and selection never call parent mutation. Same semantic String value preserves the exact escaped token and does not call parent onUse. Pure fragment-budget error preserves JSON, current directory and reviewed transaction. A real accepted text change performs parent guarded capture, updates raw/display state, invalidates preview and requires ordinary review again. For an exact approved full source, parent now validates the full prospective all-binding manifest budget before touching local text, so aggregate failure retains both fragments, review and original Save.

Output is ordinary parameter draft text only. Final creation retains strict identity-only planning, applySceneBehaviorCreateParameterSources for every binding and existing behavior.create preview/apply receipt validation. No reference-specific relation, hidden write, saved-source manifest or runtime permission is introduced.

Runtime exposes a separate read-only function guarded by live exact-true sceneBehaviorReferences capability. The saved behavior source host is not reused. The shared raw DTO is independently recaptured and branded against first-creation provenance; no saved-manifest brand is manufactured or borrowed.

The bridge transports origin and raw directory own-data records into the imported helper realm, preserving parent session/catalog/source owner identities. It never constructs a reference brand or grants host writes. Prototype normalization is fixture-only: formal malicious-prototype proofs remain the pure actual boundary tests, and this VM probe does not claim to replace Chrome.

aggregateBudgetBoundary.resolution: The root accepted preservation promise is now met for an unchanged approved full author draft. Both success and rejection still use existing identity planning and parameter validator; no protocol or pure validation relaxation. Unreviewed sibling drafts can remain incomplete and retain ordinary final Check authority.

resolvedFindings.observed: The reference helper accepts the individual fragment and clears the former approval, then the next ordinary full review refuses the aggregate overflow before dispatch. This does not persist invalid data, but fails the agreed preserve-original-draft/review promise for helper budget failure.
resolvedFindings.requestedFix: Before DOM mutation, when an unchanged valid approval exists, generate the current identity-only skeleton and test every prospective fragment through existing applySceneBehaviorCreateParameterSources. Propagate its existing error for the helper budget status; retain manual partial editing without approval.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Parent now shares createContent(identity-only skeleton + every parameter fragment) with ordinary request(). When approval is still exact, the reference callback dry-runs the prospective complete binding list before capture/textarea mutation; the existing budget error reaches the helper catch. It rechecks approval and owner before proceeding.
